scratch_trace.scope: Whole warmed cached-prefix 64-token requests, not marker-isolated decode. Timestamp bracketing is same-queue temporal association, scratch records have no dispatch correlation ID. Callback durations are not total queue stalls. Traced throughput is perturbed and is NOT benchmark evidence.

limitations: Independent process count is two per variant per stage, not twelve independent measured requests.
Telemetry1Hz measured-decode request windows include TTFT/prefill, clocks not fixed; host workloads not excluded.
Traced throughput has large asymmetric perturbation and is not benchmark evidence.
Scratch records lack dispatch correlation IDs; association uses same-queue timestamp bracketing.
PR2809 head has39 commits beyond b92eccd7 including merges; not isolated single-commit attribution.
